final: WITH rating_prices AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) AS per_day_price FROM film WHERE rental_rate IS NOT NULL AND rental_duration IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(per_day_price) AS avg_price FROM rating_prices) SELECT AVG(rp.per_day_price) AS avg_per_day, AVG(rp.per_day_price - oa.avg_price) AS avg_excess FROM rating_prices rp, overall_average oa WHERE rp.per_day_price > oa.avg_price
